senses.gloss: m. (horrearius, ὁρριάριος; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Horreum) store-keeper, steward. [Comment.: fr. אֻרְוָוה, v. אוּרְיָא, equerry.] Meg. 12ᵇ בר אהוריירֵיה דאבא thou, son of my father’s steward.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:4">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>אהוריריה</he>); <cite ref="Shabbat 113b:11">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>אהוריריה</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) <he>א׳ דרבי</he> Rabbi’s house steward (manager).
